ppe_note: Astron and MP Manganite damage eyes: goggles and face shield when you pour them. Grass Roots High K is strongly alkaline: goggles, PVC gloves and apron. Knife Plus is iron: it stains, so wipe spills straight away.
spray_rules: Range mown area only. Range closed while you're out: nobody hitting, ball picker parked
Go now: Delta T 6.3 at 11, 7.1 at 12, over 8 by 1 pm. NNW 15 km/h, gusts 22–26. Finish by 12:30. If you miss it, wait until after 6:30 pm
Keep spray off concrete paths, hitting mats and the tee line: iron stains. Boom off well short of them, more on the downwind side

spray_more: ProteSyn and Knife Plus labels: 200–350 L/ha, don't water in, wait at least 2 h before irrigating, strainer out before adding. Shadow Ultra: no rain or irrigation within 1 h, no entry without protective clothing until dry.

flags.t: High K is strongly alkaline in a tank with iron, manganese and copper
flags.d: Grass Roots High K is pH 12.4–12.8. Knife Plus carries iron and manganese as sulphates plus copper, and MP Manganite and Astron add more metals. At high pH the sulphate metals can drop out as rusty flecks and block filters and nozzles. The jar test is the check: if it flecks or curdles, leave the High K out and call Andy.
flags.s: Grass Roots High K SDS · Knife Plus tech sheet · sheet notes

Trinexapac-ethyl breaks down faster at high pH, and the High K will make this tank alkaline. Mix it and spray it out straight away; don't let it sit.

flags.d: The GreenKeeper order column has Phoz Fight 2nd, Vitalise 4th and Knife Plus last; the sheet notes give Shadow, Manganite, Knife Plus, High K, Phoz Fight, ProteSyn, Astron, Vitalise last. This page follows the notes.
Grey Wilger SR110-06 is rated 0.6 US gpm at 2.8 bar, so about 2.8 L/min at 4.1 bar. On 75 cm spacing at 7.8 km/h that's about 285 L/ha, 5% under 300. Expect a little left at the end.
